title: Neurotheology / Body–Symbol Routing Index

Use body-science-context for body↔brain physiology and scientific corrections; use the whole-brain atlas for brain anatomy/networks/flows; use brain-body-systems-deepening-wave-2 for endocrine, immune, gut, barrier, cardiorespiratory, circadian and homeostatic systems; use tim-neurobiology-relational-reconciliation when asking how Tim's own formulations relate to biology. Use specialist deepening files only when finer anatomical or theoretical detail is needed. Preserve attestation separately from later research.

owners.topic: recovered broader neurobiology / biology / chakra neighbors

use_for: House vs Temple vs Door vs Vessel

core_boundaries: Thalamus=Father's House/Potato, Pineal=Son/Door/Eye, Spine=Ladder and CSF=Spirit/River are project correspondences, not scientific identities.
Potato-shaped is canonical Potatoverse shape language for the thalamus; ovoid/egg-shaped remains the conventional anatomical description.
Single Eye / Third Eye is canonical Potatoverse and historical/esoteric language for the pineal; it is not the standard neuroscientific identity of the human pineal gland.
A real pineal↔third-ventricle relationship exists through anatomy and melatonin/CSF measurements, but this does not establish a CSF-reading third eye, present sensor or dimensional portal.
River should not be collapsed into CSF alone: biological flow is multiplex across neural, respiratory, cardiovascular, endocrine, immune, metabolic, interstitial/CSF and lymphatic systems.
Return-to-center should not be collapsed into one anatomical dot: its strongest biological neighbor is recurrent distributed regulation and state estimation.
Do not infer hidden biblical neuroanatomy from House, Eye, Seed, Ladder, river, cross, tomb, garden or temple imagery.
Do not map chakras one-to-one onto glands, ganglia, nerves or brain regions; biological neighbors are many-to-many.
Do not collapse organism communication into the vagus nerve, microbiome, hormones, CSF or any other single channel.
Legacy Great Book quantitative neuroscience claims require independent verification before scientific reuse.
Do not use psychiatric, immune, endocrine or neurological states as moral or theological proof.
Preserve Tim/user attestation dates independently from later research-unlock dates.
